name: Azure Functions and Serverless Security Assessment
description: Security assessment of Azure serverless architectures. Covers Azure Functions configurations, managed identities, bindings and triggers, API Management integration, Logic Apps, and serverless-specific attack surfaces including injection, misconfigured triggers, and over-privileged functions.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to Azure serverless security assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands Azure Functions architecture and serverless security concerns
evidence: Can explain Azure Functions execution model, triggers, bindings, and managed identities
Understands common serverless security risks in the Azure context
Familiar with Azure API Management authorization mechanisms

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Reviews Azure Functions configurations and permissions under supervision
evidence: Enumerates Azure Functions and their managed identity permissions with guidance
Identifies overly permissive function configurations using lab checklists
Reviews API Management policies for authentication gaps under supervision

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses Azure serverless architecture security
evidence: Independently reviews Azure Functions for injection vulnerabilities and insecure configurations
Assesses trigger and binding trust boundaries for abuse potential
Evaluates serverless data flows including Key Vault integration
Produces compliant Azure serverless assessment reports

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex serverless architectures; develops assessment tooling; mentors others
evidence: Assesses complex multi-service workflows (Logic Apps, Durable Functions, Event Grid)
Develops automated tooling for Azure serverless configuration review
Reviews serverless assessment work of junior analysts
Identifies novel attack chains across Azure serverless service boundaries

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines lab Azure serverless assessment methodology; publishes serverless security research
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's Azure serverless security assessment methodology
Published research on novel Azure serverless attack techniques
Trains teams on advanced Azure serverless security assessment
Recognized as authority on Azure serverless security

assessment_methods.description: Assess an Azure serverless application with intentional misconfigurations across Functions, API Management, and triggers
Given an Azure serverless architecture diagram and role assignments, identify all privilege escalation and data exfiltration paths
